lines.1: 「In the end... I suppose it's the Princess.」
lines.2: 「Mm. Well, naturally. My apologies, everyone, for starting a contest whose outcome was obvious.」
lines.4: 「Lucky you, Tsushima. Even if it was only an act, you got to hear me confess to you.」
lines.5: She gave my forehead a light poke with one finger.
